award.headline: Young Designer Wins Design Institute Award
award.excerpt: John Saju has won the Institute Designers Ireland Award 2025 for Best Service Design Project. He led the design direction on a team project.
award.excerpt2: The judges liked how he takes complicated systems and makes them feel simple and human to use. The project also pushed him to work on strategy and fine interface detail at the same time.
fullText: He did a lot of field research, watched how people actually behaved, and built quick prototypes. Then he tested them, broke them and rebuilt them until one worked.
“Good design disappears,” Saju said. “The goal was never to make something look clever. It was to make the right decision the easiest one to make.”
A trophy for the shelf, sure. But mostly it shows that good design knows when to stay out of the way.
